parsed.rationale: Eight unnamed `extension` declarations on `CGImage` are scattered across four files in two packages (`Artwork`, `AppServices`) and the `app:iOS` target. The production-side extensions in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/MultisourceArtworkService.swift` and `WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingInfoCenterManager.swift` suggest shared CGImage helpers that have been re-declared in-place rather than centralised. The test-file extensions (four entries across `ArtworkServiceTests.swift` and `ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and two in `NowPlayingServiceTests.swift`) likely duplicate the same convenience constructors or factory helpers needed for test setup. Consolidating the production helpers into a single `CGImage+Artwork.swift` extension file within the `Artwork` package (which both `AppServices` and `app:iOS` already depend on) would eliminate the scatter; test-only helpers can be consolidated into a single `CGImage+TestHelpers.swift` within the test support layer.
